Name: Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings RECOLOR
Author: Kasuralixa
Description:
I really, absolutely LOVE [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494/?]Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings[/url] but the colors just felt a little out of place in my vanilla, unmodded map--they were a little to bright for winter, so (with their permission) I made a recolor and decided to share it in case anyone else might like it! Of course, all credit goes to them and you should totally check out their other mods, they're all fantastic!! 

To install: Choose ONE of the building options, either saturated or desaturated (use the picture for reference), and copy the files into C:\Program Files ...\Stardew Valley\Content\Buildings
